Ken Tu is an engineering student at Harvey Mudd College with a humanities concentration in Foreign Languages (Chinese & Arabic). His professional interests are embedded systems engineering and consulting. Ken previously served as Co-Head Sponsor of APISPAM from 2025-2026 and plays number 6 flanker for the Claremont Rugby Club. In his free time, Ken loves to read fiction novels and watch satirical British drama.
